scope: Joint physical integration under recorded commands and voltages; no sensor feedback
limitations: Recomputes physical currents, filtered setpoints, back-EMF, motion and passive Hall signals under identical recorded drive instructions.
The observer and current regulator do not receive the new sensor readings; this is a physical refinement diagnostic, not a controlled flight.
Only the recorded movement prefix and its magnetic domain are tested.
